event_chain.summary: Claimed 12.8M user records offered for sale

summary: In September 2024 a user called 'FireBear' offered for sale on a dark web forum what they claimed was data of about 12.8 million Binance users (names, emails, phone numbers, birthdays and addresses), allegedly leaked in August. Binance said the claim was false and its security team confirmed it was not a Binance data leak.
